title: 年越しとお正月の準備
subject_en: Japanese New Year's Eve and New Year preparation motifs, each a separate item in traditional style, using vermilion, indigo, gold and ivory. No people. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: 除夜の鐘、年越しそば、しめ縄、鏡もち、初日の出。大みそかからお正月への和のイラスト12点。年末のおたよりや案内に。
items: a large temple bell hanging in a small wooden frame with a striking log
a bowl of soba noodles with tempura shrimp and green onion, steam rising
a twisted straw shimenawa rope with white paper zigzag streamers and an orange
a kagami mochi stack of two rice cakes on a stand with an orange on top
the first sunrise over a calm sea with a pine tree silhouette
a pair of kadomatsu bamboo and pine decorations tied with straw
a broom, a bucket and a cloth leaning together
a sleeping pillow with a small Mount Fuji, a hawk and an eggplant floating above
a folded paper crane and a small red and white bow
a paper lantern lit with a golden glow and falling snow dots
a hanging scroll style calendar with a red sun mark, no readable letters
a decorated hagoita paddle with a shuttlecock
